verdict.rationale: Orama does not document region selection for its managed cloud. Users can still control where data lives: Orama Cloud offers on-premise deployment on their own infrastructure, and the open-source library can be self-run with APIs designed for migrating between Cloud and OSS. Orama's Metis product runs 'in your cloud, on-prem, or dedicated'. Missing for 10: region/residency selection in the managed Orama Cloud service, documented residency guarantees (e.g. EU/US), independent corroboration.
